caption:
Exhausted from fighting to win against people? That's the wrong fight. (1 Timothy 6:12 devotional)

“Fight the good fight” — but not to defeat people. The real battle is inward: guarding the ground of who you are against greed, pride, and fear. Victory isn't winning the argument; it's finishing the race.

📌 Save this for your quiet time this week
💬 Comment below — what inner ground do you most need to guard?
